title: Voyageur Canoe Race
summary: A big birch-coloured canoe with a high prow and a crew that digs in together: the race is a sprint over a northern lake.
howToPlay: Watch the ring close on the pad and strike the moment it meets the pad.
Alternate sides with every beat: two strokes on one side drift you off line.
Keep the stroke steady through the chop and past the marker buoy, and cross the line first.
rules: A stroke on the beat gives a full push; off-beat strokes spend strength and give almost nothing.
Rough water shrinks the timing window.
Stars: first with a steady rhythm for three; first alone for two; on the podium for one.
heritageNote: Large freight canoes once carried goods and crews across the lakes and rivers of northern North America. Today teams race replicas with the same long hull and upswept ends.
